dashboard.noCaptionDesc: Cases reported within your jurisdiction will appear here as they're registered.

socio.title: Sociological Crime Insights & Policy Platform
socio.description: Place-level criminological analytics grounded in Social Disorganization Theory (Shaw & McKay). District aggregate indicators are strictly firewalled from individual person records.

metrics.compositeStressScoreInfo: Composite measure of socioeconomic stress including poverty, unemployment, and family instability indicators
metrics.literacyRateInfo: Percentage of population with basic literacy skills in the district
metrics.unemploymentRateInfo: Percentage of workforce actively seeking employment but unable to find work
metrics.urbanizationLevelInfo: Percentage of population living in urban areas versus rural

trends.title: Crime Trends & Hotspot Forecast
trends.description: Hawkes/ETAS self-exciting forecast, real temporal seasonality, MO-linkage series, and forecast-derived surveillance priorities — decomposed into chronic background risk and acute near-repeat risk.
trends.noForecastYetDesc: Run a forecast to see the hotspot map for this district and crime type.
trends.notEnoughCaseDataDesc: This district/crime-type combination has no dated cases yet.
trends.noMoSeriesDesc: No candidate same-offender series above the similarity threshold for this crime type.
trends.survRankingDesc: Top-risk grid cells from the real hotspot forecast, ranked. Not a patrol shift roster — no beat, shift, or unit-coverage data exists in this system to base one on; this ranks and labels real forecast output.
trends.noRankingYetDesc: Rank priorities to see the top-risk checkpoints for this district and crime type.

cases.noCaptionDesc: Cases reported within your jurisdiction will appear here as they're registered.

risk.title: Risk Profiling
risk.description: Central-Eight-informed, CHI-weighted risk assessment for investigative attention only — never a standalone decision. Protected demographic attributes are never used as model features.
risk.assessmentDesc: Search a person by name to compute a versioned risk score.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.pageDesc: Proactive signals for repeat offenders and organized groups — every alert traces to a deterministic detector, never a guess.
alerts.runScanPrompt: Run a scan to detect repeat-offender and organized-group signals.
alerts.nothingFlagged: Nothing is currently flagged for your attention.

network.title: Network Explorer
network.selectPersonPrompt: Select a person to explore their network
network.noNetworkDataDesc: This person has no recorded connections yet.
network.noPredictedLinksDesc: No unconfirmed connections surfaced for this person.

globalNetwork.pageDesc: Explore the whole network — persons, incidents, financial links — with filters, or ask in plain language (routed through the same assistant that powers the chat page).
globalNetwork.askPlaceholder: e.g. "show accused persons in district 1 connected by transactions"
globalNetwork.noMatchingNodesDesc: Adjust the filters above, or ask a question in plain language.

persons.title: Person Search
persons.startTypingDesc: Cross-case identity records resolved by entity resolution.

chat.title: Investigator Assistant
chat.planDesc: Plans which deterministic tool to run and narrates the result — every number comes from a tool output, never free recall.
chat.saveAsPdf: Save this conversation as a PDF
chat.emptyStateTitle: Ask about a case, person, or pattern
chat.emptyStateDesc: Try "show the network for person X" or "forecast hotspots for district 3 next week."
chat.voiceSessionActivePlaceholder: Voice session active — speak your question…
chat.typeQuestionPlaceholder: Type a question, or press the mic for a live voice conversation…

chatWidgets.gwrLocalPredictors: GWR — local socio-economic predictors of crime harm
chatWidgets.noAlertTriggeredDesc: No alert triggered — this account/list doesn't match a known typology pattern.
chatWidgets.notEnoughHistoricalIncidents: Not enough historical incidents to fit a forecast.

systemJobs.pageDesc: On-demand triggers for batch analytics jobs. GWR also recomputes automatically on a weekly schedule; embeddings are generated automatically for every newly ingested document — these buttons are for backfills and "don't want to wait for the schedule."
systemJobs.recomputeGwrDesc: Re-fit geographically weighted regression coefficients across all qualifying districts.
systemJobs.backfillEmbeddingsDesc: Embed any case narratives that predate the automatic embed-on-ingest path.

models.title: Models
models.pageDesc: Every ML model's held-out quality, feature importance, and fairness posture — the evidence behind each automated insight (capability #9).

documents.title: Documents
documents.uploadDesc: Runs the full ingestion pipeline for any supported format (FIR PDF, chargesheet, history-sheet, statement audio, news HTML, CSV/XLSX). News lands in staging and needs explicit promotion (§2.2 — never auto-merged).
documents.ocrDesc: Local mode only reads digital-text PDFs; scanned images/handwriting need Zia OCR (OCR_PROVIDER=zia).
documents.pasteTextPlaceholder: Paste narrative text, or send OCR output here...
documents.pageDesc: Upload evidence for full ingestion, run OCR on a scanned/digital file, or extract named entities from text — provider is configurable (OCR_PROVIDER/NLP_PROVIDER: local, zia, or gemini for NER).

policyRecommendations.title: Criminological Policy Diagnostic
policyRecommendations.description: Automated preventive interventions grounded in criminological theory and district socio-economic risk factors.

socioCorrelation.description: Empirical Pearson correlation ($r$) comparing socio-disorganization factors against Crime Harm Index (CHI) vs. Raw Counts.

urbanizationChart.title: Urbanization & Social Disorganization Velocity
urbanizationChart.description: Tracks crime velocity shifts during rapid urban expansion events (grounded in Shaw & McKay's Social Disorganization Theory).

victimDemographics.title: Aggregate Victim Socio-Demographics
victimDemographics.description: Place-level aggregate distribution of victim cohorts across crime categories for proactive resource deployment.
victimDemographics.ageCohortExposure: Age Cohort Exposure by Crime Type (%)
